purpose: Expose authored infection-source and mutagen-cloud scenes used by the prototype slice.

runtime_contracts.mutation_cloud_presence_v1: Active clouds deliver optional on_mutagen_cloud(delta_seconds) to unobstructed absorb_mutagen visitors once per physics frame, including permanent/spent/refused sources. Presence metadata is transient on each visitor; mutagen budget/dedup remains separate. Legacy heals_visitors receivers without the callback use capped once/frame healing.
